description: PLATFORM-FIDELITY-02 Diamond Princess larger-seed follow-up: the corrected hull-fidelity contrast (proxy mega_cruise_5000 vs event-faithful diamond_princess) at the frozen operating point, extended from the 01b 20-seed series to 200 seeds/arm by the pre-registered power calculation in campaigns/covid/platform_fidelity_02/power_analysis.py. Theta 7.9e6, infection_age_days 6.8, imports 1, sanitary_visit_mode dwell_weighted, union exempt_work_zones data/config/protocols_covid_pf_dp_01b.json — all frozen. Both arms are rerun over the full series so the campaign is self-contained; the first 20 dedicated seeds double as the in-image replication row against PLATFORM-FIDELITY-01b. Pre-registered sensitivity measurement; no Theta selection, no platform crowning, no GM cells.
base_overrides_note: The boxed crew-mess configuration, verbatim from covid_crew_mess_01_design.json arm sect_mess_boxed (the DP believability operating point per docs/covid/covid_dp_replay_handoff_2026_10_09.md section 2), applied by the 02 cell worker after prepare_cell_run_spec. Identical to the PF-01/01b DP designs; only protocols_path, seed count, and campaign identity differ.
cells_note: 1 theta x 1 infection_age x 1 imports x 2 arms x 200 seeds = 400 enumerated cells. The seed series is the contiguous boarding-screen block 20200205..20200404 (seed_base + i), extending the frozen 01b series 20200205..20200224. Campaign blocks split the same 400 cells as dp_t7e6_dedicated_canary (20), dp_t7e6_dedicated_rest (180), and dp_t7e6_proxy (200); submission is canary-first, then owner-approved remainder.
cell_payload_additions_note: The PF-01/01b payload set, unchanged. The crew_window witness blocks carry the exemption-policy evidence per cell: at_activation and at_end working_crew_count / working_crew_by_posted_zone, boxed service_deliveries active epochs, and crew_meal_service mode.

arms.note: First arm so empty overrides per the arm grammar. Rides the scenario's declared proxy platform mega_cruise_5000. Rerun over all 200 seeds under the same union protocols file so the PF-02 proxy arm is self-contained (the union list was proven inert on this hull in the 01b preflight).

Same cell on the event-faithful diamond_princess hull (159 zones, 57 AHUs; PR #1167) with the frozen union exempt_work_zones. The only difference from the baseline arm is catalog.platform_id plus the shared protocols_path. Seeds 20200205..20200224 replicate the 01b dedicated cells in-image.

freeze.power_basis: campaigns/covid/platform_fidelity_02/power_analysis.json: smallest grid n with >=0.90 power on P(takeoff) and both-takeoff paired size at the observed 01b plug-in rates, and >=0.80 on both under halved event rates; selected 200 seeds/arm (400 cells).
metrics: primary P(takeoff): per-arm fraction of all 200 seeds with recorded_onsets >= 10; exact two-sided McNemar on discordant pairs (proxy-only vs dedicated-only), alpha 0.05
primary both-takeoff outbreak size: per-seed dedicated - proxy recorded_onsets on seeds where BOTH arms record >= 10 onsets; one-sample t on the deltas, two-sided alpha 0.05, mean delta with 95% t CI
paired delta median with q05-q95 on both-takeoff seeds, labelled a SEEDWISE SPREAD, NOT a confidence interval

reported, never selected: unconditional onset burden per arm (median, total, mean recorded_onsets over all 200 seeds) with Welch t as context only; takeoff-conditional asymptomatic share of lab_confirmed per hull; CRN Pearson rho; dedicated-only and proxy-only takeoff counts
failed-comparison audit: any cell whose protocol engine fired a close_zones protocol is a FAILED COMPARISON, reported, never deleted
freeze.minimum_detectable_effect: No smaller effect is claimed: n=200/arm is powered for the observed 01b effects (P(takeoff) 0.50 vs 0.30; both-takeoff mean paired delta +109 onsets) and remains >=0.80 powered under halved event rates. Failure to reject is 'unresolved at this n', never platform equivalence.
report_immediately: any cell where a close_zones protocol fired (FAILED COMPARISON)
any witness or input-hash-contract audit failure
any primary endpoint rejecting at alpha 0.05 (reported as a measured platform-fidelity effect, not as a platform selection)
freeze.stopping_rule: Fixed n=200 seeds/arm with no interim significance looks and no extension. The campaign-gate canary (20 dedicated seeds, 20200205..20200224) is read out first; the remaining 380 cells run only after owner approval. A technical-failure rate above 10% or any witness/hash audit failure stops the array for diagnosis.

execution.submission_order: canary dp_t7e6_dedicated_canary (20 cells) -> local/Batch readout and STOP -> owner decision -> dp_t7e6_proxy (200) + dp_t7e6_dedicated_rest (180). No GM cells, no Theta or seed changes, no union-list retuning.
